company: Osaka University Ishiguro Lab / JST ERATO
company_native: 大阪大学 石黒研究室 / JST ERATO
target_applications: HRI research: mobile childlike android for conversational relationship-building and public-space studies

base_type.value: wheeled mobility unit: 2 active wheels + eccentric wheels (horizontal sway) + ball-screw vertical oscillation (mimics human CoM motion)

height_mm.source: modeled on ~10-year-old child; ~120 cm per press/paper

weight_kg.source: press reports garbled ("37 pounds"); not reliably disclosed

payload_per_arm_kg.source: expressive gesture arms/hands; no manipulation payload

torso_lift.value: vertical oscillation mechanism (ball-screw) for gait-like body motion, not a work lift

actuators.value: fully electric actuation (unlike earlier pneumatic Ishiguro androids)

end_effector.value: 5-finger expressive hands (hand signs, gestures); latex skin on face/hands

software_stack.value: lab dialogue/HRI stack; used in ERATO and Moonshot avatar studies

deployment_evidence.value: lab and public demonstrations (hand-holding walk demos, telepresence studies); no deployments

notes: Mobile counterpart to static ERICA/Geminoid androids. DoF cited as 46 (incl. wheels) in Robotica paper, 47 on lab page.
